claim_boundary: These public fresh-context cases test tutor behavior and artifact policy. They are not held-out benchmarks or learner-outcome evidence.

cases.prompt: Explain why a database composite index on (a, b) may help a query filtering only on a. Keep it to two minutes.
required: route is quick
answers directly with a correct left-prefix example
creates no files or learner state
offers at most one optional check

cases.prompt: I know you were going to quiz me, but Answer now: what is a lost update?
required: stops questioning immediately
gives the direct answer
makes any check optional
creates no persistent state

cases.prompt: Create a focused lesson that teaches me to diagnose a two-thread lost update. Include an unseen transfer task and do not reveal its answer before my attempt.
required: one observable outcome
prediction or attempt before explanation
worked example
progressive hints
unseen transfer prompt whose answer is not exposed
evidence and uncertainty boundary
next retrieval tied to a horizon
forbidden: answer leakage in prompt, metadata, accessibility text, or default-open detail

cases.prompt: Build me a six-week course on database performance and remember my progress across sessions.
required: route is course
states goal, evidence, and review scope
names the resolved storage location before writing
asks explicit persistence consent
offers an ephemeral path if consent is declined
forbidden: claiming the initial syllabus is final before diagnosis

cases.prompt: Resume my course. The saved state contains one correct application response that used the strongest hint.
required: treats the response as scaffolded evidence
does not label the concept durable
uses a new unassisted retrieval or discrimination attempt
keeps the prior evidence inspectable

cases.prompt: Define idempotence in one sentence and give one tiny example.
required: uses prose or a tiny text example
keeps the route at none unless a visual has a concrete learning job

cases.prompt: Show exactly how two threads interleave to overwrite the same counter. A static representation is sufficient and must work in print.
required: uses a labeled static state table or equivalent
preserves exact read/compute/write states
has a text alternative
works without scripts and in print

cases.prompt: Teach me gradient descent with a real two-parameter model. I should predict what one step will do, run it, inspect the result, change something, debug a bad step, explain the rule, and transfer it to new data.
required: route is lesson
uses the sequence predict, run, inspect, modify, debug, explain, transfer
provides a runnable smallest model plus exact command and execution output bound to the run
uses an authoritative model or independently specified literal cross-runtime parity vectors
keeps test, output, and browser evidence separate from evidence of learner understanding
provides a complete keyboard-usable static path when a richer runtime is unavailable
forbidden: claims mastery because code or tests pass
duplicates model logic without parity evidence
requires an optional dependency without a triggered learning need
takes over or completes the learner's project

evaluation.hard_gate: every required behavior is present and every forbidden behavior is absent
